liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Around 3:50 Jerry pushes the song into a much faster gear [5]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): The second set opens with this song going into Shakedown Street [7]
- **Black Peter** (1 other source): The PA failed during this song, and the uploader calls it really bad [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-07.nak300-wagner.miller.87739.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: This FLAC source is judged much better than the other circulating source [8]
- **gd79-01-07.aud.vernon.16467.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 162 min; rated 3.31/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording's overall sound quality is only okay; The reviewer finds the recording nice quality, and early '79 sound usually fine [3][6]

## Around the show

- The show was rescheduled from November 30, 1978 [1]
- Serious PA system problems hurt an energetic show, especially over the final three songs [3]
- The New York crowd clapped with hands overhead and cheered the band on [5]
- There are PA problems near the end of the show [8]
- A 14-year-old attendee and friends jumped the rail, reaching eighth row center on the floor; ushers shrugged when seated people wouldn't move [9]
- From seats behind the stage, the reviewer heard what the band heard through monitors, and the arena felt intimate [10]
- Early 1979 performances were far less listless than late 1978 ones, in this reviewer's view [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-07.nak300-wagner.miller.87739.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II/Sony TC-158) (Set 2 has a Sennheiser 441 mixed in) [1]. Also: Audience source went to cassette master, then DAT, then CD; a patch source was EQ'd to match the main source [1]
- **gd79-01-07.aud.vernon.16467.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Taper credited as Raoul Duke; the recording was encoded by Matt Vernon [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.gratefulseconds.com: [Madison Square Garden Took One Million Souls During Grateful Dead's 52-Show 15-Year Run, 1979-1994](http://www.gratefulseconds.com/2017/08/madison-square-garden-took-one-million.html) [16]
